newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia's Nov import price index unchanged.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia's Nov import price index unchanged.

text.p: Australia's import prices were unchanged in November from the previous month and stood 6.5 percent lower than a year ago, the Australian Bureau of Statistics said on Thursday.
Apart from November's unchanged result and a rise in August, Australian import prices have fallen in every reported month of 1996.
The annual rate of import price inflation swung from a peak of 5.3 percent in October 1995 to a trough of minus 8.2 percent in May. The annual rate has tended to rise since then.
